audience: fitness studios that run classes, bookings and client passes in bsport

useCases.title: Check upcoming classes and their capacity
useCases.text: List classes by start window, teacher, venue or service. Get one class to see its capacity, bookings and waitlist size.

useCases.title: Look up a client and their passes
useCases.text: Search clients by email or id, then list the class passes and subscriptions that the client owns.

useCases.title: See who is booked and waiting for a class
useCases.text: List the bookings of a class with their status. Then get the waitlist of the class in position order.

useCases.title: Book a client into classes
useCases.text: Book one client into one or more classes with a client pass. The booking uses credits and can notify the client.

useCases.title: Record attendance and tag a client
useCases.text: Mark one booking as attended or not attended. Then add a tag to the client. Attendance can trigger no-show rules.
